Group rides in Virginia

13 recurring group rides around Virginia: 8 road, 4 social, 4 mountain bike. 9 roll on weeknights, 4 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Tuesday Night Ride (NoVA Casual Bicycling Group) in Arlington — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Saturday Bridge Ride (Blue Ridge Cyclery / BikeFitRVA Racing) runs 16–19 mph.
